text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After class, I see Super Creek and<n>Rice Shower
wearing costumes in the<n>classroom...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I thought as much. Lowering the lightsin the dorm would be dangerous.Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, y-yes... I think so, too

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. ♪ We're making<n>arrangements for the
Cross-Dorm<n>Dare-Off. Rice and I make up the
executive committee.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We've finished with the costume<n>fitting, so now
we're organizing the<n>tests of courage.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Coming up with interesting ideas has<n>been
surprisingly tough, though...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I don't think I'm very good<n>with scary
stuff...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's note down everything<n>we've come up
with so far.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? That's a little odd. The lead's<n>not coming out
of my mechanical<n>pencil.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-well, I can make a memo on my<n>phone so—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Why can't I turn it on?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It's happening again! I've<n>brought more bad
luck!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Creek. I knew it was a<n>bad idea to
have me on the Dare-Off<n>Committee...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Don't say things like that.<n>You haven't
done anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's ghosts that are to blame forthese mishaps! They saw ourcostumes, thought we were friends oftheirs, and floated on over.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh? Ghosts? B-but those aren't...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There! Can't you feel it? I can sense<n>a spook
getting closer as we speak...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Swish...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek! My leg! Is that... a ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's actually just Super Creek<n>brushing her tail
across Rice<n>Shower's leg, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It seems like this ghost is partial to<n>pranks, don't
you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she wants me to play<n>along. I'll try
shaking the desk<n>without Rice Shower noticing it's
me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
AAH! The desk is shaking?!<n>Wh-wh-what should
we do, Creek?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret, it's all right. I'll keep you<n>safe and
sound.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me, you... silly spookster!<n>Scaring Rice is a
big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...It's gone quiet. Did the ghost...<n>leave?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yep! I've chased it right off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... wh-what if it comes back?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll chase it off again! As many<n>times as I
have to. I'll keep you<n>perfectly safe!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So don't you worry about it, and let's<n>get on with
our committee meeting.<n>Okay, Rice? ♪
choice_data_list: I think you'll both do fine!
I think you'll both do fine!

If you get spooked again, you can let Creek look
after you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So don't you worry about it, and let's<n>get on with
our committee meeting.<n>Okay, Rice? ♪
choice_data_list: I think you'll both do fine!
I think you'll both do fine!

If you get spooked again, you can let Creek look
after you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Just leave everything to this<n>Mummy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I tend to get frightened easily,<n>so I'm not sure
I'll be able to perform<n>my duties too well, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll try my very best to make sure the<n>Dare-Off is
fun for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. I know you can do it, Rice.<n>You already
overcame your fears<n>today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, they both go on to have<n>an amazing
exchange of ideas,<n>making for a very successful
planning meeting!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'll coddle you good and<n>proper. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, a-actually, I'm still a little...<n>frightened, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there. Don't you worry now.<n>"Mummy" is
right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, and I'm happy to coddle you as<n>well, Trainer.
That's what "mummies"<n>are for, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Dare-Off planning meeting<n>continues
with Super Creek providing<n>copious amounts of
coddling.
